One arc per 32 births: a particle's place along it and the arc it belongs to

Free in space it turns over, each axis at its own rate as far as it has flown. Once down it settles flat over 0.2 s, laid on the ground and turned the short way round on each axis
Sized at random, and no size until released, so the shards held in the dome are not drawn
Born all over the dome, a sphere's surface with its lower half folded up
